info.title: Invoice Ninja Universal API
info.description: Create invoices, manage clients, track expenses, and get paid

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

action.description: Bulk action to perform, such as archive, restore, delete, template, assign_group, or bulk_update.

ids[].description: Array of client IDs to include in the bulk action.

column.description: Required for bulk_update. Invoice Ninja supports columns including public_notes, industry_id, size_id, country_id, and custom_value fields.

newValue.description: Required for bulk_update. New value to set on the selected column.

include.description: Optional related records to include in the response, such as contacts, documents, activities, ledger, or system_logs.

contacts.description: Client contact records returned by Invoice Ninja.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp when the client was created.

has_valid_vat_number.description: Whether the VAT number is valid.

is_tax_exempt.description: Whether the client is tax exempt.

public_notes.description: Public notes shown on client-facing documents.

updated_at.description: Unix timestamp when the client was last updated.
